purpose: Test whether a source-traceable, nuisance-explicit conventional lens mapping can reproduce the 21 spectroscopic RX J2129 image positions without importing the published convergence map, source reconstruction, residuals, or best-fit mass parameters.
disclosure: Before this freeze, the Jauzac et al. image table, seven spectroscopic source families, the paper's 0.5-arcsec per-coordinate likelihood convention, its reported aggregate 0.29-arcsec model RMS, and the existence of published PIEMD parameters were known. No independent model residual, source position, lens parameter estimate, train/holdout score, or model-A-versus-model-B comparison had been evaluated.

cosmology_and_coordinates.coordinate_convention: x is east and y is north in arcseconds from the frozen BCG center
cosmology_and_coordinates.source_redshift_scaling: Every mass-plane deflection is parameterized at z_source=2.0 and rescaled by D_ds/D_s to each spectroscopic family redshift. Source redshifts are fixed observables.

likelihood.source_positions: Two free nuisance coordinates per source family, profiled analytically at each lens parameter vector.
likelihood.optimization_residual: For each observed image, transform its source-plane displacement from the profiled family source through the inverse local lens Jacobian. This is a first-order image-plane residual used only for numerical optimization.
likelihood.validation_residual: Solve the nonlinear lens equation from each labeled observed-image basin with the source fixed by the training images, then score the exact predicted-versus-observed image-plane displacement. Optimization residuals cannot satisfy an advance gate.
likelihood.covariance_rule: Use the frozen 42x42 coordinate covariance exactly. Do not add unpublished off-diagonal astrometric covariance.
likelihood.conditional_label_caveat: The exact validation is conditional on the published image labels and initializes one root solve in each observed-image basin. It is not a survey-completeness or missing-image likelihood.

blind_split.training_rule: Use images ending in .1 and .2 in every family.
blind_split.heldout_rule: Hold out the image ending in .3 in every family.
blind_split.selection_information_allowed: Only training-image coordinates and fixed non-lensing nuisance inputs may affect fitted parameters.
blind_split.heldout_use: The seven exact heldout image residuals may select between the two predeclared nested nuisance models, but may not tune their form, priors, or bounds.

model_A.name: smooth_plus_central_stars
profiles: one non-singular isothermal ellipsoid for the smooth cluster-scale Weyl field
one spherical Hernquist term for unresolved total central stellar light
model_A.interpretation: A conventional interpolation of the lensing deflection field, not a dark-matter detection and not an alternative-gravity fit. Because the BCG/ICL split failed, the central term is a broad total-light nuisance and is not labeled BCG or ICL.

model_B.name: smooth_plus_central_stars_plus_members
model_B.added_profiles: One spherical pseudo-Jaffe profile at each of the 66 frozen candidates inside 30 arcsec.
model_B.fixed_member_inputs: Catalog position, geometric-mean Molino size, stellar mass, and expected membership probability.
model_B.membership_sensitivity: After fitting, repeat exact scoring over 64 pre-indexed correlated membership-bootstrap vectors. This sensitivity cannot refit or select the mass model.
model_B.interpretation: A predeclared structural-nuisance test. Its shared mass ratio is not a measured subhalo mass function.

optimization.method: bounded scipy least_squares with deterministic multi-starts
optimization.selection_objective: training likelihood plus the frozen weak parameter priors
optimization.post_selection_refit: Refit the selected nuisance model to all 21 images without changing its form, bounds, or priors.
optimization.covariance: Report the local observed-Hessian/Laplace covariance for lens parameters and source coordinates; label it engineering-only if rank deficient or if an exact residual gate fails.

failure_rules.heldout_failure: Keep the observable likelihood but mark this mass family inadequate; do not tune or add components after seeing which image failed.
failure_rules.all_image_failure: Do not promote RX J2129 to a reconstructed Weyl-response pilot. A new lens family requires a new disclosed protocol version and must be evaluated on a new holdout split or a different system.
failure_rules.covariance_failure: Retain point estimates as diagnostics only; no dynamical-versus-Weyl comparison is authorized.
